title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 5 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: I get up at six thirty every day.
I brush my teeth and wash my face.
What time do you go to school?
I go to school at seven twenty.
We have four classes in the morning.
I do my homework after dinner.
I go to bed at ten o'clock.
Every day is a busy day.
